report.summary: Analyzed chunk 1 of graph_delta.py: defines module docstring, load_mutations, LayerDelta, DeltaResult, _ast_refs, _literals_by_function, _module_literals, _literal_keys, _structure_by_function. Claims enumerated.
risks: _ast_refs | medium | The function name 'CLEAN arm' is misleading; it actually drops docstrings and uses AST, not raw source, so it is not the 'clean' arm described in the docstring (the docstring says the first run used raw source and found SEEDED/DEFECT). The function as implemented does exactly what the docstring says it should do, but the naming may confuse readers. | Clarify naming or add a comment that this is the AST-based reference layer, not the raw-source layer that was removed.

handoff.purpose: Define module overview, mutation corpus loader, delta data structures, and AST-based reference/literal/structure extraction functions.

symbols.name: load_mutations
symbols.note: Imports mutation corpus from tools/gate_discrimination.py; registers module before exec to avoid dataclass errors.

symbols.name: LayerDelta
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass representing a layer delta with added/removed names.

symbols.name: DeltaResult
symbols.note: Dataclass holding mutation result; has detected/detected_leaky properties and SCORING_LAYERS constant.

symbols.name: _ast_refs
symbols.note: Extracts identifier references from AST, counting per function and flattening to a multiset of strings.

symbols.name: _literals_by_function
symbols.note: Extracts constant values per function as a Counter; repr clipped to 80 chars.

symbols.name: _module_literals
symbols.note: Extracts module-level constants from assignments; repr clipped to 80 chars.

symbols.name: _literal_keys
symbols.note: Combines module-level and function-level literals into a set of unique keys.

symbols.name: _structure_by_function
symbols.note: Docstring only; function body not in this chunk. Claims to record node types and nesting depth.

observations.what: The module docstring contains extensive predictions and rationale, but no code in this chunk implements the actual delta comparison or evaluation logic.
load_mutations registers the imported module in sys.modules before exec to avoid dataclass definition errors, which is a subtle but correct workaround.

The SCORING_LAYERS tuple excludes 'code.refs.leaky' as documented, but the comment says it's excluded because it scans raw source and would be moved by comments. The code in this chunk does not define 'code.refs.leaky' nor any raw-source scanning layer.
Multiple functions (_ast_refs, _literals_by_function, _module_literals) have docstrings that refer to specific mutations (e.g., FREE_LANES, --no-textconv) that are not present in this chunk.

_ast_refs uses a Counter and then flattens to a set of strings with multiplicity encoded as '#i' suffix. This preserves count information but uses string formatting that may be fragile if names or counts contain '#'.
The function _structure_by_function is only partially present; its docstring is complete but the body is cut off at the end of the chunk.
